newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Sept 6.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Sept 6.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:

Lend Lease Corp Ltd said on Friday it was budgeting for an increase in profit after tax and earnings per share in the current year to June 30, 1997. Lend Lease posted a net profit of A$280.0 million for 1995/96, up from A$260.10 million the previous year. It set a 47 cent final dividend, up from 38 cents the previous year.
QBE Insurance Ltd said on Friday it was to buy the U.K. reinsurance operations of Allstate Insurance Co for A$70 million.

WMC Ltd late on Thursday announced a 20.4 percent leap in annual profit and vowed to continue aggressive expansion by developing resource projects worldwide. WMC reported net equity profit of A$386.2 million (US$305 million) for the year ended June 30 and declared an 11 cent final dividend, up from 12 cents. Analysts had expected about A$400 million.

Forrestania Gold NL expects to substantially upgrade the resource at its proposed Maggie Hays nickel project in Western Australia after identifying high-grade intercepts from an in-fill drilling program, managing director Barry Eldridge told Reuters late on Thursday. Forrestania said grades for the entire mineralised zone should be in the 2.0 percent to 2.5 percent nickel range and the intercepts found were amoung the best recorded in the exploration history of the Australian nickel industry.

Joe White Maltings Ltd said on Friday that an increased takeover offer by Ridley Corp Ltd remained inadequate. "Ridley's increased offer of A$5.30 recognises, in the clearest possible way, the validity of the board's earlier comment that the initial offer of A$4.85 was inadequate," Joe White chairman S.E.K. Hulme said in a statement.

TNT Express Worldwide plans to launch a new intra-European express service, Euro 1, later this month, TNT said in Paris overnight. From September 30, TNT will be offering customers a next-day before 9 a.m., time-guarantee express service, from 17 European countries.
